aplQuery:
['moltnet-logs']
| where body == "task.readiness.useful_event_received"
| extend task_id = tostring(['attributes.taskId']), latency_ms = todouble(['attributes.queuedToUsefulMs'])
| summarize latency_ms = min(latency_ms) by task_id
| summarize p95_ms = percentile(latency_ms, 95)
description: Task queue-to-first-useful-output p95 is at least 30 minutes. This is a workload readiness/backlog signal, not HTTP handler latency. Inspect the MoltNet Task Readiness dashboard and daemon capacity before changing request-latency thresholds.
name: MoltNet task readiness p95
